title: Task-State Migration Receipt (WI-486 SIB-30..35)
description: Terminal receipt for an explicit, authorized on-disk task-state migration or restore. Every disk rewrite path emits exactly one of these; a failure emits one with terminal_result=failed and never reports the state as upgraded (SIB-34).

digest.description: sha256 of the authorization file bytes

principal.description: verified authority principal that authorized the operation (EXEC-006)

nonce.description: single-use nonce from the verified authorization (EXEC-006)

repository.description: repository the authorization is scoped to (EXEC-006)

changed_paths.description: task-graph paths whose bytes were rewritten (empty on already-migrated / failed-before-write)

backups.description: immutable byte-for-byte backups taken BEFORE any mutation (SIB-32)

before_digests.description: path -> sha256 of the exact bytes before migration

after_digests.description: path -> sha256 of the exact bytes after migration (equals before on failure/idempotent)

terminal_result.description: SIB-33/34/35 + EXEC-R2-006/007: exactly one outcome. failed/rejected/corrupt never means upgraded; `corrupt` marks a rollback that could not restore the verified original. `eligible-dry-run`/`restore-dry-run` are NON-TERMINAL simulations that changed nothing and must NOT satisfy a completed-migration/completed-restore check.

failure_reason.description: present when terminal_result is failed, rejected, or corrupt
